name: Taihou Daigaku Byouin no Kyouki - Dai Roku Ya
original_name: 大鳳大学病院の狂気 第六夜
source:
Once More into Hiroko's Enema Hell

Amid a complex relationship of hospital funds and embezzlement, Yamaguchi's wife and lover have both ended up in a dubious experimental study. The contracts have been signed, there is no backing out. Yamaguchi must choose one person to "free" from sexual persecution.

The content of the study is forced public excretion.

"It's time to choose. Will you excuse your wife or your lover from the experiment? Whichever you choose, one of them will have to suffer the consequences."

Who do you want to make scat herself in humiliation?

translation:
再次进入阿弘子的灌肠地狱

在医院资金和贪污的复杂关系中，山口的妻子和情人最终都陷入了可疑的实验研究中。合同已经签订，没有反悔的余地。山口必须选择一个人来“摆脱”性迫害。

研究内容是强制公开排泄。

“是时候做出选择了。你会原谅你的妻子还是你的爱人参加实验吗？无论你选择哪一个，他们都必须承担后果。”

你想让谁羞辱自己？
